recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person musical group portrait set against a weathered wooden backdrop, featuring heavy, stylized slab-serif typography integrated with delicate ornamental swirls. The color palette is warm and desaturated, emphasizing wood textures and formal yet relaxed attire.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between heavy, blocky lettering and thin, elegant line flourishes
Symmetry of the trio seated on a high-backed wooden bench
Integration of text into the upper third of the composition
Textural harmony between the wooden background and the desaturated skin tones
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif display type with internal decorative cutouts
Thin, circular vector flourishes surrounding the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The trio is centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure acts as the vertical axis, while the large-scale typography anchors the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large, dark typography at the top, move down to the central figure, and then scan left and right to the other band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space, primarily found in the upper corners around the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans from the wood and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark navies in the clothing and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp whites in the shirts to provide highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark text/vests and light shirts/background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochrome

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with western influence
letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight contrast between thick stems and thin horizontal bars
Internal decorative notches or 'spurs' on the midpoints of vertical strokes
Heavy, blocky serifs with slight rounding at the corners
Integrated thin-line flourishes that wrap around and through the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'L' feature extended flourishes that blend into the background art

anatomy.strokeCharacter: Solid with internal decorative negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scales and ornamental additions.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy western slab-serif feel with internal decoration.
Provides the necessary spurs and western character.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of three people (two men, one woman) in smart-casual rustic attire (vests, white shirts) sitting on a large, high-backed dark wood bench. The background is horizontal weathered grey-brown wood planks. Apply a warm, desaturated vintage filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, centered, extra-bold slab-serif text at the top. Surround the text with delicate, thin black circular flourishes and swirls that weave between the letters.

verificationChecks: Text is legible despite the heavy weight
Flourishes do not obscure the letterforms
Color grading is consistent across subjects and background
Typography feels integrated into the rustic theme

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wood grain texture
Spacing between the two lines of text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the slab serifs have the characteristic 'western' spurs
Check that the flourishes are thin enough to contrast with the heavy type
Verify the wood grain is horizontal and weathered
Confirm the trio is centered and balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Wood Background + Centered Trio Portrait + Heavy Western Slab Serif + Delicate Vector Flourishes + Sepia Toning.
